title: A lane dropped from two batches leaves the queue for a fix lane
why: Plan R26 part 2 (owner; restart-plan). Owner 13:15 CST Nov 12: "how do you propose us getting the merge queue faster?"
note: A lane dropped from two batches in a row leaves the merge queue and goes to a fix lane, so it stops holding later batches. Red first. Plan R55 (owner 13:19 and 13:21 CST Nov 12, restart-plan 4fefc9f, pick d: "Express lane, and cancel a running batch for it too"): a reviewed merge-flow lane goes to main as its own batch, ahead of all others; the batch runner cancels a batch run already in CI, and that batch then merges main in. Home: skill ci-hygiene step 8. The owner chose this over the one-batch-in-turn rule.
